content.title: Trail Blazers vs. Suns NBA play-in game 2026: Where to stream live, start time, betting odds
content.text: Portland Trail Blazers center Yang Hansen (16) dribbles back down the court during the second half of an NBA basketball game against the Phoenix Suns on Tuesday, Nov. 18, 2025, in Portland, Ore. (AP Photo/Molly J. Smith)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By John Holland | The Oregonian/OregonLiveTonight’s NBA action features your Portland Trail Blazers taking on the Phoenix Suns in this exciting NBA Western Conference Play-In game. The winner secures the #7 seed and faces San Antonio in the first round. The tip takes place at 7 p.m. PT/10 p.m. ET (8 p.m. MST) on Tuesday, April 14, and the only way to watch is streaming on Amazon Prime.What TV channel is the Trail Blazers vs. Suns NBA play-in game on tonight, or is it streaming only?When: 7 p.m. PT/10 p.m. ET (8 p.m. MST) on Tuesday, April 14Where: Mortgage Matchup Center in Phoenix, AZWhat TV channel is the game on? Amazon Prime Video is not a TV channel, and there is no TV broadcast for this game. This game is only available to watch live streaming on Amazon Prime.How to watch the game streaming live: You have to sign up for Amazon Prime ($14.99/month or $139.00/year) to watch this game live on your TV, computer, phone, or tablet with the Prime app. To sign up, follow the instructions on Amazon Prime, and it will walk you through the process.
